description.zh: 值为**true**时，Cert、Key、EncryptCert、EncryptPrivateKey、SignCert、SignPrivateKey信息不返回，**false**时则返回，默认是false。
description.en: Specifies whether to filter the certificate content from the response. Valid values: **true**: The Cert, Key, EncryptCert, EncryptPrivateKey, SignCert, and SignPrivateKey parameters are not returned. **false** (default): All parameters are returned.

description.zh:
证书ID。
> 此ID可通过调用[ListUserCertificateOrder](~~455804~~)获取。
description.en: The ID of the certificate. To get this ID, call the [ListUserCertificateOrder](~~455804~~) operation.

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: The queries per second (QPS) limit for each user is 100. If you exceed this limit, the system throttles your API calls, which may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation within this limit.
